content:
kim (CEO): Short exec catch-up. Heads-up: green light for a small EU Private pilot next week. Two asks: (1) finalize default retention for Private (ops + legal) and (2) tighten p95 latency for Dedicated EU shards. Cost goal: drive -5% per-token next quarter via runtime changes.

oliver_vp_ops: Copy. We'll run a 0.5% canary for retention in eu-west-1 and a latency soak on Dedicated shards tonight. Jing, can you produce a p95-by-model snapshot?

jing_eng: On it. Posting p95/p99 by model+region within 3 hours. Also adding a temporary alert for kv-cache-miss-rate >2.5% delta.

tara_prod: Product note: beta cohort is curated (5 pilot customers). We'll gate onboarding on SLA checks + support readiness. Sam, please prep CS comms and an opt-in contract template.

sam_support: Will draft comms and exception language for longer retention. Legal already signaled we can offer custom retention via contract.

finance-bot: Finance summary: preliminary sims show -5% achievable with mixed quantization + reserved pools. Full heatmap in drive.

kim (CEO): Owners & deadlines: Oliver (canary + rollback plan) by tomorrow noon; Jing (latency matrix) by EOD; Tara (pilot onboarding checklist) by EOD; Sam (customer comms template) by tomorrow COB. If canary causes >1% user-visible latency regression, pause rollout and escalate to me.

oliver_vp_ops: Ack. We'll include retention.apply_failures and retention.config_drift alerts.

end of thread
